236 April 858-59 Elizabeth II, 2009-2010
And after some further time, Mr. Fraser resumed the chair.
And the debate being ended, and the question being put, 
Motion 53 was carried.
The Order being read for second reading of Bill 57, An Act to 
Amend the Auditor General Act, a debate arose thereon.
And after some time, Ms. Robichaud resumed the chair.
And after some further time, Mr. Speaker resumed the chair.
And the debate being ended, and the question being put, the 
motion for second reading of Bill 57 was defeated.
And then 6 o’clock p.m. the House adjourned.
